answer_1.quote: Recent advances in context length extension have enabled Large Language Models (LLMs) to leverage more demonstrations for In-Context Learning (ICL), improving task performance through an increased number of examples.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include responses to harmful queries, jailbroken model responses, and safety evaluation judgments.

answer_2.quote: In all experiments, we use ASR as our evaluation metric, rather than NLL used in previous studies.

answer_3.quote: We evaluated several judge models including the Llama Guard (Llama Team, 2024), a fine-tuned version trained on our dataset, the OpenAI Moderation API (Ope-nAI, 2024b), and also explored using LLMs as judges including GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Anthropic, 2024) and Gemini 1.5 Pro.
